name: Bipolar
overview: Scripture reveals that in times of emotional turmoil and brokenness, God draws near to those with a contrite heart and offers salvation and strength. Believers are encouraged to trust wholly in the Lord rather than their own understanding, finding stability in Him as their rock and defense. By keeping their minds focused on God and waiting patiently upon Him, they can experience perfect peace and renewed strength, even when facing inner struggles. God's promise to uphold and help His people assures them of His sustaining presence amid life's challenges.
